## Projects

- **MarketQuad**: A secure, student-only marketplace for the University of Victoria community. Enforces verified access to eliminate spam and unsafe interactions, enabling trusted peer-to-peer campus transactions. Full-stack production system with authentication, real-time interactions, and scalable data management. Stack: React Native, Expo, Next.js, TypeScript, Cloudinary, Prisma, Supabase, PostgreSQL.

- **uEyes**: A real-time assistive vision system for visually impaired users. Streams live camera input to an AI model that generates contextual scene descriptions, retains short-term visual memory, and supports natural conversational queries. Built for low-latency communication and stateful context handling. Stack: React, FastAPI, Firebase, Python, WebSockets, Google Gemini, Tailwind, Docker.

- **uBlog**: A complete CRUD desktop admin blogging system with local storage handling. Tested with the Unit Test framework following DAO protocol. Stack: Python, PyQt6, Unittest, Git, Linux, CSS.

- **Survey Parser**: A high-performance C-based data parser that processes raw survey data and converts it into structured, analysis-ready datasets using Likert scale normalization. Stack: C, Memory Management, Bash, Git, Linux.

- **TopShop**: A full-stack shopping system with an AI-powered estimation engine that generates real-world price predictions as users build lists. Combines a RESTful backend with dynamic data entry. Stack: JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Mongoose, EJS, Tailwind CSS, Google Gemini.

- **MacBook Redesign**: A pixel-perfect, responsive recreation of Apple's M4 MacBook Pro landing page featuring 3D model rendering and scroll-driven animations. Stack: React, Three.js, GSAP, Tailwind CSS, WebGL.

- **VST Fingers**: A real-time computer vision interface that transforms hand movements into expressive control signals for DAWs. Maps finger motion to MIDI/OSC parameters for touchless interaction with virtual instruments. Applications in creative performance, accessibility, and motor rehabilitation. Stack: Python 3, OpenCV, MediaPipe, OSC, Max9, Audio Processing.
